title: Replying to @its.raining.ben Show number 5 may just be my favorite so...
transcript: hi, I'm Ben. I'm seeing 7 shows in 7 days, and this is show number 5 and Juliet. so it's time for me to come clean. I am not the biggest fan of jukebox musicals. I like some of the bio musicals, but in general, especially the jukebox musicals with original. stories. I'm really traditionally not a huge fan of, so I very much went into the show with tempered expectations. and I was honestly very pleasantly surprised that I actually really loved the show. it is so much fun the songs are super well utilized and the cast is absolutely incredible. I was especially impressed with Betsy Wolf, who's an actress. I've been a really huge fan of for a while. and it feels like she hasn't really had an original role to, like, really sink her teeth into and, like, show everything that she can do, and so I'm so glad that she has this role now. um, and I just think it is absolutely perfect for her. her comedy style fits perfectly with the show. I think she's a lock for a Tony nomination. and honestly, I could see her winning. I also really loves Lorna Courtney as Juliet. she's an actress that I was not super familiar with before seeing the show. but her vocals are absolutely insane. and I love the personality that she brought to Juliet. she's honestly one of those people that you watch and you are like, yes, you are going to be a star one day. truthfully, the entire cast is really great. there is not a weak link in the bunch. and I thought the story was honestly really great. I find a lot of jukebox musicals tend to prioritize style over substance, and I thought that this one had a really great mix of spectacle. but also a really touching story that had a lot to say. I also thought the choreography was really impressive. I'm not someone who is normally wowed by choreography. I'm usually just like, yeah, that was really good dancing. but honestly, like, the choreo in the show. I found to be really impressive. the design work is also pretty great across the board. the set is pretty simple, but well utilized. some really great lighting, and I love the costumes. I love the way that they blended the Shakespearean style with the modern style. so, yeah, if you can't tell the show is a big recommendation for me. I highly recommend checking it out. if you can. I think it's gonna be running for a while. it'll definitely tour. so if you get a chance to see the show. definitely go see the show. thanks for watching and I'll see you tomorrow for show number 6.
reasoning: Ben expresses strong enthusiasm despite his general skepticism of jukebox musicals, calling it a 'big recommendation' and saying he 'highly recommend[s] checking it out.' His praise is comprehensive, covering cast, story, choreography, and design.
